storage_port_ingress_restriction.title: Storage Port Ingress Restriction Level
storage_port_ingress_restriction.description: Describes how strictly ingress traffic is filtered on storage service ports. Reflects whether only explicitly allowed source CIDRs/zones may reach these ports.

untrusted_zone_direct_access_allowed.title: Untrusted Zone Direct Storage Access Permitted
untrusted_zone_direct_access_allowed.description: Indicates whether network traffic originating from untrusted or semi-trusted zones can reach storage service ports directly without passing through an access tier or proxy layer.

ingress_default_deny_enforced.title: Default-Deny Ingress Policy Enforced on Storage Zone
ingress_default_deny_enforced.description: Indicates whether the storage zone boundary enforces a default-deny posture for inbound traffic, requiring explicit allow rules for any permitted source.

egress_policy_enforced.title: Egress Policy Enforced on Storage Zone
egress_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether an explicit egress filtering policy is applied to the storage zone boundary that restricts outbound connections initiated by storage components.

default_egress_action.title: Default Egress Action for Storage Zone
default_egress_action.description: The default action taken for outbound traffic from the storage zone when no specific egress rule matches — either allow or deny.

allowed_egress_destinations.title: Allowed Egress Destinations from Storage Zone
allowed_egress_destinations.description: List of explicitly permitted outbound destination CIDRs or hostnames for the storage zone. An empty list combined with a default-allow posture indicates unrestricted egress.

zone_boundary_authentication_mode.title: Zone Boundary Authentication Mode
zone_boundary_authentication_mode.description: Describes how trust is established at the storage zone boundary — whether a single boundary-level credential grants implicit access to all internal services or each service requires independent authentication.

intra_zone_service_authorization_enforce.title: Intra-Zone Per-Service Authorization Enforced
intra_zone_service_authorization_enforce.description: Indicates whether authorization policies are independently enforced for each service inside the storage zone, rather than relying solely on trust granted at the zone boundary.

storage_services_sharing_single_trust_cr.title: Storage Services Share Single Trust Credential
storage_services_sharing_single_trust_cr.description: Indicates whether all storage zone services accept the same boundary-issued credential, token, or certificate without service-specific scoping or restrictions.

lateral_movement_controls_present.title: Lateral Movement Controls Present Within Storage Zone
lateral_movement_controls_present.description: Indicates whether explicit controls exist to prevent lateral movement between services within the storage zone after zone boundary entry, covering both network and service-level enforcement.

credential_scope_isolation.title: Credential Scope Isolation Enforced
credential_scope_isolation.description: Indicates whether credentials and service accounts used to access storage zone components are exclusively scoped to the storage zone and not shared with or reusable by principals in adjacent zones.

shared_service_account_zones.title: Zones Sharing Service Accounts with Storage Zone
shared_service_account_zones.description: List of zone identifiers whose service accounts or credentials overlap with those used in the storage zone for database or object storage authentication.

cross_zone_credential_rotation_independe.title: Storage Zone Credentials Rotated Independently
cross_zone_credential_rotation_independe.description: Indicates whether storage zone credentials are rotated on a schedule independent from adjacent zone credentials, preventing shared rotation cycles that imply shared credential material.

network_policy_enforced_between_db_and_o.title: Network Policy Enforced Between Database and Object Storage
network_policy_enforced_between_db_and_o.description: Whether a network policy or firewall rule explicitly restricts east-west traffic between the database service and object storage service within the storage zone.

intra_zone_default_traffic_policy.title: Intra-Zone Default Traffic Policy
intra_zone_default_traffic_policy.description: The default traffic policy applied to east-west communications between components within the storage zone. Also reflects the intra-zone segmentation level for monitoring purposes.

shared_network_segment_with_database_and.title: Database and Object Storage Share Network Segment
shared_network_segment_with_database_and.description: Whether the database service and object storage service reside on the same flat network segment without any logical boundary between them.

east_west_traffic_inspection_enabled.title: East-West Traffic Inspection Enabled
east_west_traffic_inspection_enabled.description: Whether traffic inspection (IDS/IPS, deep packet inspection, or inline monitoring) is applied to lateral traffic between storage zone components.

east_west_traffic_logging_enabled.title: East-West Traffic Logging Enabled
east_west_traffic_logging_enabled.description: Whether flow logs, connection records, or audit logs are generated for lateral traffic between storage zone components, enabling forensic detection of intra-zone movement.

management_traffic_network_segment_separ.title: Management Traffic Network Segment Separated
management_traffic_network_segment_separ.description: Whether management and orchestration traffic traverses a dedicated, isolated network segment separate from the application data-plane segment at the storage boundary.

boundary_acl_differentiates_management_p.title: Boundary ACL Differentiates Management Protocols
boundary_acl_differentiates_management_p.description: Whether ingress/egress ACLs or firewall rules at the storage zone boundary explicitly identify and separately control management protocols versus application data protocols.

management_protocol_source_restriction.title: Management Protocol Source Restriction Level
management_protocol_source_restriction.description: The level of source IP/network restriction applied to management and orchestration protocol traffic at the storage boundary.

presigned_url_generation_enabled.title: Presigned URL Generation Enabled
presigned_url_generation_enabled.description: Indicates whether the object storage service is configured to allow generation of presigned URLs or delegated access tokens that grant time-limited direct access to storage objects.

presigned_url_accessible_from_external_z.title: Presigned URLs Accessible from External or Less-Trusted Zones
presigned_url_accessible_from_external_z.description: Indicates whether presigned URLs or delegated tokens can be redeemed by clients outside the defined storage trust zone without traversing zone ingress controls.

presigned_url_max_validity_seconds.title: Maximum Presigned URL Validity Duration (Seconds)
presigned_url_max_validity_seconds.description: The maximum permitted lifetime in seconds for generated presigned URLs or delegated tokens. Longer durations increase exposure if a URL is intercepted or shared beyond its intended recipient.

ingress_cidr_prefix_length.title: Ingress CIDR Prefix Length (Minimum)
ingress_cidr_prefix_length.description: The shortest (most permissive) prefix length found among all ingress rules on the storage zone boundary. Smaller values indicate broader, less restrictive address ranges.

egress_cidr_prefix_length.title: Egress CIDR Prefix Length (Minimum)
egress_cidr_prefix_length.description: The shortest (most permissive) prefix length found among all egress rules on the storage zone boundary. Smaller values indicate broader, less restrictive destination address ranges.

service_tag_or_specific_ip_used.title: Service Tags or Specific IPs Used in Rules
service_tag_or_specific_ip_used.description: Indicates whether storage zone boundary rules reference named service tags or specific host/service IP addresses rather than broad CIDR blocks.

mutual_tls_enforced.title: Mutual TLS Enforced at Zone Boundary
mutual_tls_enforced.description: Whether the storage zone boundary requires mutual TLS, meaning both client and server must present valid certificates for all service-to-service connections crossing the boundary.

client_certificate_validation_mode.title: Client Certificate Validation Mode
client_certificate_validation_mode.description: The mode in which client certificates are validated at the zone boundary ingress. required means all connecting clients must present a valid certificate; optional means certificates are accepted but not required; none means no client certificate validation is performed.

internal_zone_traffic_authentication_byp.title: Internal Zone Traffic Authentication Bypass
internal_zone_traffic_authentication_byp.description: Whether traffic originating from internal or trusted network zones is exempt from authentication requirements at the storage zone boundary, allowing service-to-service calls without presenting credentials.

dns_resolver_restricted_to_internal.title: DNS Resolver Restricted to Internal Authoritative Resolver
dns_resolver_restricted_to_internal.description: Indicates whether storage zone components are configured to use only an internal authoritative DNS resolver, blocking direct external DNS queries.

egress_dns_port_restricted.title: Egress DNS Port (53) Restricted at Zone Boundary
egress_dns_port_restricted.description: Indicates whether outbound DNS traffic (UDP/TCP port 53) from the storage zone is explicitly blocked or restricted to approved internal resolver endpoints at the network boundary.
